column1: # The level 1 template table (bead tla-7xql.4, epic tla-7xql).
# A template is a named family of items with one generating idea. The grouping
# matters because bead tla-7xql.1, the stem-blind gate, runs PER TEMPLATE: the
# artifact it hunts is template-local, and a pooled number hides a bad template
# behind good ones. So the template is a column in swipe/level1/ITEMS.tsv and
# not a comment.
# Rows are tab-delimited and carry the literal marker TPL in field 1, so prose
# in this file can never be read as data. Read rows with awk -F'\t' or cut,
# never with IFS=$'\t' read: tab is IFS whitespace, so a run of tabs collapses
# and an empty field vanishes.
# A TPL ROW. Five fields, in order, and they are the level 0 five:
#   1  marker      the literal TPL
#   2  id          E1 and up, stable, never renumbered
#   3  name        three or four words
#   4  idea        the generating idea, one sentence
#   5  calibration the reading/ models the family was shaped against
#   awk -F'\t' '$1 == "TPL" && $2 == "E1"' swipe/level1/TEMPLATES.tsv
#   grep '^TPL' swipe/level1/TEMPLATES.tsv | cut -f2,3
# THE IDS ARE E-PREFIXED AND NOT T-PREFIXED. Level 0's five are T1 to T5, and
# a level 1 template sharing one of those ids would make a pooled reading of
# the two corpora silently merge two families that have nothing to do with
# each other. The stem-blind instrument takes --items, so pointing it at the
# wrong table is one flag away and the id is what catches it.
# THREE TEMPLATES SHIP HERE AND THE RUNG STOPS AT THREE. Bead tla-7xql.4
# shipped E1 as a pilot and proposed the rest, and Frank sized it on
# 2026-10-18: three templates at 48 each, 144 items, and stop. Level 0 ships
# five at 48, and that 48 is the stem-blind gate's power floor rather than a
# fact about the corpus, so it carries to this rung unchanged.
# THE SPLIT IS BY CLAIM SHAPE AND NOT BY SUBJECT AREA, which is where level 1
# departs from level 0. Level 0's five templates split by TLA+ subject, which
# works because a level 0 item is about whatever its expression is about. At
# level 1 the question kind is one thing throughout, so what a reader actually
# experiences as a different family is the SHAPE of the claim: a named action
# at a state, a quantifier over a parameter, or a whole state against every
# action it has. That is three, and bead tla-7xql.13 records the argument
# against a fourth: the shapes left over are the same question in new clothes.
# EACH TEMPLATE IS ITS OWN REGISTRY ROW. A level 1 item cannot batch, because
# every item carries its own pin, so the gate's cost is linear in items and
# one row over three templates would be the second-largest in the registry.
# harness/test-swipe-enabled.sh takes --template so each row pays for its own
# template, and one template's growth does not move the others.
TPL
